title: Every Clause Counts: Instruction-Following Reranking by Multiplying Small, Answerable Questions
abstract: arXiv:2611.03179v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: People often attach instructions to their search queries, asking for pages written for beginners, documents in a certain language or official sources only. Most rerankers were trained to judge topical relevance and treat such instructions as a few extra words. On the InfoSearch benchmark, even GPT-4o used as a list-wise reranker reaches an average WISE (Weighted Instruction Sensitivity Evaluation) of only 33.5. We present DMReranker (Decision-Model Reranker), a zero-shot reranker that splits an instructed query into a topic and a short list of typed clauses. A small judge model answers one narrow question per clause, and the answer probabilities are multiplied into a single score. Nothing is trained, and the configuration was frozen before the test runs. Reranking the same top-100 candidates as the published baselines, DMReranker reaches a macro WISE of 50.9 over all six InfoSearch dimensions while keeping original-mode nDCG@10 at 82.9

translated_title: 每个子句都至关重要：通过连乘小型可回答问题实现遵循指令的重排序
translated_abstract: 人们常常在搜索查询中附加指令，例如要求页面为初学者编写、文档为某种语言或仅限官方来源。大多数重排序器（reranker）被训练用于判断主题相关性，并将这类指令视为几个多余的词语。在InfoSearch基准测试上，即使是作为列表式重排序器使用的GPT-4o，其平均WISE（加权指令敏感度评估）也仅达到33.5。我们提出了DMReranker（决策模型重排序器），这是一个零样本重排序器，它将带指令的查询拆分为一个主题和一串带类型的子句。一个小型评判模型针对每个子句回答一个狭窄的问题，然后将答案概率相乘为单一分数。该方法无需任何训练，且配置在测试运行之前就已冻结。在与已发布基线相同的top-100候选结果上进行重排序时，DMReranker在全部六个InfoSearch维度上达到了50.9的宏观WISE，同时将原始模式的nDCG@10保持在82.9。
tldr: DMReranker将带指令的查询拆分为主题和多个子句，让小型评判模型逐一回答并连乘答案概率，无需任何训练即可将指令敏感度（WISE）从33.5大幅提升至50.9，同时保持原始相关性排序性能。
en_tdlr: DMReranker splits instructed queries into typed clauses answered by a small judge model with multiplied probabilities, achieving zero-shot instruction-following reranking that boosts WISE from 33.5 to 50.9 without any training while preserving original relevance performance.
